verdict.rationale: Chargebee can be driven fully headlessly. It offers a REST API with HTTP Basic Auth API keys, official SDKs (e.g. npm install chargebee), idempotency keys for safe retries, async export jobs and webhooks. A community user also describes separate dev/staging/prod environments with their own webhook URLs. missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific documentation, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe found all candidate paths 404), and hands-on corroboration of CI pipeline usage.
